tei:div.tei:p: (137)bla ma yi yal gyis rang lugs grub mtha'i rnam bzhag spyi dang*/ khyad par rnam mkhyen rtag pa la/ smon lam skabs sogs mkhas par grags pa'i dge bshes kha shas 'jal ba/ rnam mkhyen rbag dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes ni/ chos dbyings 'dus ma byas dang*/ gnyis snang phra mos kyang ma gos par nub nas nam yang rjes thob du ldang ba'i skabs med par chos dbyings de bzhin nyid dang gnyis med ro gcig tu chu la chu bzhag pa ltar tha mi dad pa yin dgos shing*/ chos kyi dbyings ni 'dus ma byas ngo bo nyid kyi rtag pa yin pa rang sde theg chen pas khas len dgos na/ ye shes 'dus byas kyi tshugs ma shor bzhin du/ chos kyi dbyings su gnyis snang nub lugs de/ rig pas sgrub rog nan gyis zhus kyang tshig gcig sgrub mkhan ma byung*/ gzhan ka ba dang ka ba'i stong nyid gnyis gcig yin na/ ka ba mig gis mthong ba ltar/ stong nyid kyang mig gis (138)mthong dgos la/ yang na stong nyid la gzugs med pa ltar ka ba la yang gzugs med par thal ba sogs rno rno byed mkhan mang du byung lags kyang*/ tha snyad du/ ka bar gzugs med/ stong nyid la gzugs yod zhes sus kyang khas mi len/ gnas lugs la de gnyis tha dad na 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag gi dus su yang tha dad dgos kyis/ gnyis snang nub pa mi 'thad de/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i kyang chos thams cad kyi gnas su lugs mthar thug lhag ma med par rtogs pa las/ de bas lhag pa'i rtog bya med pas na/ gnas lugs la ka ba dang ka ba'i chos nyid ro gcig pa'i gnad kyis gnyis snang nub song ba lags shing mdo rgyud kun kanas zung 'jug dus ma byas byis blos mi rtogs pa rgya cher bsngags pa ltar mi pham mkhas pas bshad pa lags sam zhus tshe khyed bden ces khas ni gang la len/ 'on kyang zung 'jug 'dus ma byas 'gogs pa'i rig pa stobs ldan smra ba ni su ma byung*/

'bras spung blo gsal snying 'dan ma khang tshan nas/ dge bshes kyi mtshan (139)rtag ma bzhes/ 'a na ma blo gces rtsis pa'i dge rgan/ des mi pham la rtsod lan bgyis pa ro ces grags pa che bas ci 'dra bris ma mjal lags/ ༄༅/ bar chad bdud kyi rtags ni/ rang tshod mi mthun pa'i lha mthong 'dre mthong phyi ru zhal gzigs sogs ltar nyams sna tshogs shar ba de yin/ bar chad yin rtags de la zhen pa che zhing 'jig rten dang jo mthun la chos dang rang rgyud je 'gal du 'gro 'phel 'grib nyams rtags la shes nyams snang nyams gnyis/ shes nyams la shes pa dga' bde'i nyams mthar 'gyur gyi nyams gnyis las/ dang po ni sems nyams yin/ de la dngas snyigs gnyis las sems dngas ba'i nyams bde gsal mi rtogs snying nas mi rtag sogs glo bur ba/ snyigs nyams byang rgod sdod snying*/ mi 'dod pa chags sdang drag po glo bur du skye ba sogs yin/ des sun mi dgos sbyong sman btang ba ltar nyams len gnad du song*/ rtags bag chags (140)ngan goms bslang ba yin gsung*/ mthar 'gyur gyi nyams rlung rtags yin/ de la dngas snyigs gnyis las/ snyigs nyams lha mthong 'dre mthong sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan dbyings thig sogs ma nges/ mi 'gyur gsang rtags la khregs chod ltar snying nas mi rtag blo sna thung ba sogs rgyun chags la yod dgos/ rgyun chags su med par glo bur ba re byung yang gong gi shes pa dwangs nyams tsam las gnad rtags min/ thod rgal la de'i steng du snang shes kyi nyams gnyis ka'i nang tshan snang nyams bslu med kyi rtags kyis snang bzhi bsgrod dgos pas de gsang rtags min/ gnyis ka zung 'jug tu bsgom pa la de'i stong du skra dkar dang gnyer ma med pa sogs rjogs chen rang gzhung nas bshad pa'i rtags rnams kyang 'ong dgos song*/ nyams thams cad bsdu na 'jig rten pa'i nyams dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i nyams gnyis su 'du/

dang po ni rtogs pas ma zin pa'i zhi lhag thun mongs pa'i nyams thams cad yin/ nyams thams cad la bzlas ro (141)snyom nas rtog pas zin pa'i rtogs nyams zhen med thams cad 'jig rten las 'das pa'i nyams yin/ dang po nyams rtog shan phye lta bas la bzlas/ sgom pas lam du khyer/ spyod pas ro snyom/ nyams bzang ngan thams cad/ lus kyi rnam 'gyur/

ru shan rko rkyong stag song mig gi lta stangs bying phar rgod yar khro bo khro mo ngag gi brjod pa ha hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ sems kyi bsgom bshig nyams rtog bor btang bshig khrol/ ༄༅/ e ma skal bzang rig pa 'jin/ 'di ltar snang ba'i dngos rnams la/ bden par 'jin rtog log pa'i blo/ gnas lugs don gyi bzhugs tshul zhing*/ zang thal 'gags med phyogs lhung bral/ gsal mdangs 'od lnga'i drwa ba can/ zhal phyag spangs pa'i ye shes pa/ 'di las logs na yod re kan/ snang sems mnyam nyid 'dres pa'i dus/ ming yang rtog btags ma gtogs pa'i/ bden pa med de stong pa'i gdangs/ snang la snang dus dag pa che/ 'od gsal bde ba'i rol mor 'char/ lha'am (142)yang na bdud kyang rung*/ ye shes bla ma'i ngo bor shar/ 'di la bzang ngan yod re kan/ e ma lhun grub rmad po che/ ma bcos 'gyur med rig pa la/ bcos pa'i blo yis reg pa bral/ bla ma'i drin las tshogs med rnyed/ ma bsgom yongs pa'i skabs bral la/ dran pa'i rje bo yod re kan/ glo bur rtog tshogs bde ba'i klong*/ rang grol babs kyi bde ba la/ de ring gnas na mi legs sam/ ha ha las kyi rdo rjes so//
